Estación de servicio de buena atención pero al momento de brindar servicios ya es una atención escasa con mi abuelo de 89 años intentantamos ir al baño siendo las 18:40 y nos dijeron que están cerrados los baños y no había otros a donde mi abuelo pueda ir. Es horrible q no respeten a los mayores y a sus necesidades y a uno mismo por que su supuestamente hay baños deberían estar habilitados, y entiendo que últimamente está la zona llena de gente en situación de calle pero tampoco es manera de dejar a la gente que encerio necesita ir al baño.

(Translated by Google)
The gas station has generally good customer service, but when it comes to providing services, they're inadequate. My 89-year-old grandfather and I tried to use the restroom at 6:40 PM, and they told us the restrooms were closed and there were no other options available. It's awful that they don't respect the elderly and their needs, or even ourselves, because if there are supposedly restrooms, they should be open. I understand that the area has recently become full of homeless people, but that's no way to leave people who really need to use the restroom.

Sobre casi todos los servicios de Aca son muy buenos pero le coloco  2 estrellas al personal de atención en trámites de licencia de conducir. Son horribles!!  Te tratan de muy mala manera. Te dicen la información a medias. Te contestan con sarcasmo violentos   Ejemplo. Un señor  le quiso mostrar algo a la que atiende. Y le respondió que no puede ver cosas personales y le dio el ejemplo de : yo no me meto en su heladera a ver qué tiene adentro!   A mi marido y a mi nos trato también muyyyyy mal.  A otros lo mismo.  Ambas personas. Se nota que ya estan hartas de atender al publico. A otra persona la mismo.  Vuelvo a decir. Un espanto!  Lo peor fue q fuimos a actualizar datos de la licencia y cuando ve en pantalla  que la camioneta tenía una multa. Me dice q debo abonar sino no se puede seguir el trámite. Ok.  Cuando va mi marido lo mismo pues el vehículo está a nombre de los dos.  Nos emite 2 facturas de pago de la multa con diferentes códigos de barra. Dando entender  que teníamos q paga r dos veces la misma. La miramos y le pregunto  como se hace x cual se abona. Cero respuesta.  Obvio q uno deduce lo malo pero no se. Nos vamos. Mi marido entra a la web de CABA. ( xq fue alla) y lo abono x un app virtual. Volvemos y vuelve a decir q no le impactó. Ok. Suele tardar pero insistía con que la deuda era x DNI. Y mo es asi. Es x la camioneta.   Listo.  La verdad un desastre y es una entidad privada.  En ese sector un desastre de elección de personal.  Habiendo muchos  otros q tiene talento xa la atención al público y tiene a esta dos personas maleducadas. Reiteró no fuimos nos los único mal tratados.   Resultado? Nos fuimos y nos acercamos a la muni y nada que ver!  Diez puntosssss.  La atención de la municipalidad de Mar del Plata.     Basta de gente violenta.

(Translated by Google)
Almost all of Aca's services are very good, but I'm giving the driver's license processing staff two stars. They're awful! They treat you very badly. They only give you half the information. They answer with violent sarcasm. For example, a man wanted to show something to the woman who was helping him. She replied that she couldn't see personal things and gave him the example of: "I don't go into your refrigerator to see what's inside!" She treated my husband and me very badly too. The same thing happened to others. Both of them. It's clear they're fed up with dealing with the public. The same thing happened to another person. I'll say it again. Awful! The worst thing was when we went to update the license information and when she saw on the screen that the truck had a fine, she told me I had to pay it or the process couldn't continue. Okay. When my husband went, the same thing happened because the vehicle is in both our names. She issued us two payment receipts for the fine with different barcodes. Implying that we had to pay the same thing twice. We looked at her and I asked how it was done, which payment method was used. Zero response. Obviously, you deduce something bad, but I don't know. We left. My husband went to the CABA website (because he was there) and paid it through a virtual app. We went back and she again said she hadn't received it. Okay. It usually takes a while, but she insisted that the debt was based on the ID number. And that's not the case. It's for the truck. Done. Honestly, a disaster, and it's a private entity. In that department, the staff selection is a disaster. There are many others who have talent for customer service, and they have these two rude people. I repeat, we weren't the only ones mistreated. The result? We left and went to the municipality, and it was nothing like this! Ten out of ten! The service at the Mar del Plata municipality. Enough with these aggressive people.

reviewReply.comment:
Buenos días Mónica, entendemos tu disgusto, pero ese Servicio no lo brinda el ACA, lo realiza la Municipalidad, a quien daremos traslado de tu reclamo.
El ACA le ofrece el espacio a cambio que sus Socios tengan un turno prioritario.
Saludos.
